title: Q-YEAR-SIM-token-revoked: capacity stays at 0.6 after it, for good
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** the year simulation (YEAR-SIM-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe token-revoked
**Status:** open

Fault class `token-revoked`: capacity stays at 0.6 after it, for good. Drill evidence: expiring detected: expiring; revoked detected: invalid; renewal of the credentials the loops use: ['auto', 'auto']; revocation needs one sign-in through /connect, the per-run Actions token keeps merging meanwhile

Build the mechanism that recovers from it without a person, then the drill in foundation/yearsim.py must exercise it.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe token-revoked` exits 0.
